purpose: Reduce redundant face-target detection attempts with an explicit 200 ms start cadence; do not change the person detector or identity decision rules.
required_invariants: Keep the current single camera publisher and its latest immutable frame ownership.
Keep YOLO/ByteTrack models, thresholds, scheduling and output geometry unchanged.
Keep face DPU model hashes, detector thresholds, matching and ambiguity thresholds, 1000 ms TTL and epoch/generation rules unchanged.
Use the latest pending source frame only after the cadence wait; never return a fabricated or re-stamped cached detection.
Keep original face processing, face observation, enrollment sampling, source guards and operator ABI/recovery lifecycle hooks.
Leave the protected r17 entry and all old source/configuration files untouched; use an independently pinned candidate entry and source manifest.
Do not modify native libraries, checkpoint, consumed markers, BOOT/FDT/firmware/VART or mechanical protections.
Do not claim CPU savings from fewer detector calls alone or audio readiness from synthetic scheduler tests.

hold_equal: display frame rate and animation load
audio source PCM and 20 ms pacing
audio frontend threads and process priority
measurement_design.primary_cpu_evidence: Read-only process/thread CPU deltas over the same monotonic measurement window; report whole-board and camera deltas separately.
measurement_design.scheduler_evidence: Actual face detection attempt start gaps, processed/overwritten counters, source frame IDs and existing freshness/discard counters; no image or biometric template export.
measurement_design.audio_evidence: Actual public PCM paced full frontend/ASR/encoder composition with the original bounded eight-frame queue and unchanged fail-on-overflow gate.
measurement_design.functional_evidence: Original face absence/multiple-face/expiry/source-epoch/enrollment tests and same-source checks plus bounded-start/latest-pending/close tests.
measurement_design.temporal_cost_to_report: An explicit 200 ms detector cadence can add up to one extra 100 ms sampling interval per observation relative to a 100 ms cadence. Initial confirmation/reacquisition latency must be measured, not described as identical.
acceptance: A measurable paired reduction in camera and/or whole-board CPU work beyond run-to-run variation.
No source freshness, ownership, native recovery, person tracking or original identity decision regression.
No silent audio frame drop, queue-size expansion, model/threshold relaxation or lower display frame rate.
Audio real-time and queue acceptance remain separate actual gates; detector call reduction alone does not satisfy them.

deployment: Not selected. Parent must review independent pins and serial single-publisher/native-owner handoff steps before any hardware action.
